nodes.label: Landing Page Spec — Carnet de Voyage (#/hero)
Carnet de Voyage Editorial Style
nodes.rationale: Editorial travel journal look (Editorial Grid/Magazine x Nature Distilled, validated via ui-ux-pro-max): warm paper surfaces, ink typography, photos as pasted prints, travel ephemera as component language. Chosen because the previous Cinematic/Aurora layer read as machine-generated.

nodes.label: Paper/Ink Token Palette
nodes.rationale: --paper/--ink family plus hairline rules, tape and stamp tokens in tokens.css; both themes defined and dark mode is a 'night edition', not an inversion.

nodes.label: Film Grain Overlay
nodes.rationale: Inline SVG turbulence overlay (~5% multiply light / 3.5% screen dark) on the page root; explicitly must not be removed because it is what kills the flat digital look.

nodes.label: Letterpress Buttons
nodes.rationale: Solid fill, 1.5px ink border, hard offset shadow 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); hover lifts, press sinks. No glow, no gradients, no pills — print-inspired physicality instead of glossy web chrome.

nodes.label: Travel Ephemera Component Language (artifacts, not cards)
nodes.rationale: Each content block maps to a physical travel artifact: rotated photo prints (hero), pinned prints (places), boarding-pass tickets (itineraries), postcards (moods/testimonials), typographic manifesto (why), letter card (partner form), fare stubs (pricing), almanac ruled row (stats), masthead nav. Replaces generic feature cards; no icon boxes, no avatars, no count-up numbers.

nodes.label: Rotation Etiquette (--tilt)
nodes.rationale: Tilts (±0.4°–4°) per nth-child via the CSS rotate property so translate-based reveals stay independent; hover straightens to 0°; reduced motion keeps the tilt but freezes transitions.

nodes.label: Banned AI Tells
nodes.rationale: Explicit ban list for this page: canvas particles, mesh orbs, gradient text, pill announcement badges, count-up stats, dicebear/stock avatar stacks, glassmorphism, neon glows, icon-in-gradient-box cards, fake online counters — all read as machine-generated aesthetics.

nodes.label: Landing Accessibility Rules
nodes.rationale: Decorative SVGs aria-hidden; star rows carry aria-labels; 3px --mediterranean focus outline; prefers-reduced-motion stops ticker and reveals; --ink on --paper ≈ 12:1 contrast with --ink-faint reserved for ≤11px mono labels.

nodes.label: Landing QA Gotchas
nodes.rationale: QA-learned traps: global h2 color rule beats inherited section color on ink sections; .ej-postcard-sig span selector out-specifies .ej-hand; .ej-reveal holds opacity 0 until observed so full-page screenshots look empty; the PWA service worker serves stale hashed chunks after rebuild — unregister before visual verification.

nodes.label: Cinematic/Aurora Landing Spec (retired)
nodes.rationale: Previous landing layer (mesh orbs, particles, pulse strip, gradient headlines) retired from #/hero because it read as machine-generated; its legacy .tn-landing system is still used by Partner/About (partner-v3, about-v3) and must be kept.
